content.comment_body: Hello, I am attempting to update my [product_name] software to [version_no]. I visited [url], but when I tried to access the Windows 64-bit option, I was redirected to a page stating the requested content is no longer available. How can I obtain the upgrade? Thank you.
That's odd—I had no issues using Firefox. You could try downloading directly from this link: [url] (copy and paste it into your browser). Did this solution work for you?

Hi, Alternatively, you can utilize the upgrade center feature within [product_name] ([document]: Help -> Upgrade Center). If you're operating on Windows 7 or Windows 8, make sure to start [product_name] with administrator privileges. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users wanting to upgrade [product_name] to [version_no] experienced broken links and redirection issues on the official [company_name] website, particularly for the Windows 64-bit installer. These access issues made obtaining the update challenging. Suggestions included using a direct link or the upgrade center within the software itself, though some operating systems required starting the application with administrator rights.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect straightforward, functional access to the latest upgrade of [product_name] for Windows systems through the [company_name] website.
